original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.

actual_scope: For one source, two dirty outputs and a two-coordinate connector over F2, extend the common-A broadcast readout from identical maps to A0=C and A1=C+D with rank(D)=1; derive and verify the exact two-prefix schedule and its full local break-even invoice.
scope_change_reason: The already completed PR1707 broadcast covers identical output maps. This task keeps its one broadcast operation but changes the output-map hypothesis to a nonzero rank-one residual and charges every residual readout, extra target update, route and dispatch.
bottleneck_link: If a recursive supplier's output maps share an expensive common core but differ by a cheap low-rank residual, one common-core evaluation can serve both dirty targets while the correction is evaluated separately; the displayed inequality determines whether the added writes and routing leave a saving.
stop_rule: Use exactly one active source, two outputs, L=2 over F2, and the two-prefix word B0 B0. Prove the symbolic identity and exhaust all dirty source, connector, target and scratch states for the fixed full-rank C, rank-one D fixture. Stop after the exact invoice and four negative controls; do not search longer words, larger matrices or suppliers.
evidence: verify.py checks all 1,024 dirty states for B=I2, C=[[1,1],[1,0]], D=[[1,0],[0,0]], and C+D=[[0,1],[1,0]]. The source, dirty connector and scratch are restored/preserved; both targets receive the exact required increments. Four semantic negative controls and one nonzero-residual control pass. The complete declared tariff fixture costs 23 units for separate readouts and 21 for the broadcast-plus-residual schedule; the symbolic saving is 2(c_(C+D)-c_D-w-r) plus the schedule-level dispatch difference. Direct replay passed on Python 3.14.7 under -I -O -B and package metadata/pins passed. The registered Python 3.12 replay was not run locally because Python 3.12 is unavailable. No selected supplier or κ change is claimed.
author: OpenAI Codex research agent
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematical scope, derivation, exact verifier, cost model and writing. No subagents or independent model output were used.
